_comment: The cost-routing case study on the Automation Lab page. Figures are Nour's own, from his published write-up: a vision model reading a PDF costs roughly four times what a text model costs to read the text already inside it. Prose lives in copy.automation.caseBody; only the numbers and the branch shape live here.

fallback.en: Extraction came back empty? The PDF was only a scan — send it back to the vision branch.
fallback.ar: عاد الاستخراج فارغاً؟ إذن ملف PDF كان صورة ممسوحة فقط — أعده إلى فرع الرؤية.

basis.en: 1,000 receipts a month, half PDF, half photos
basis.ar: ١٠٠٠ إيصال شهرياً، نصفها PDF ونصفها صور
